newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 6.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan holds news conference Wednesday (today) on prospects for Ivory Coast's economy
- Visiting head of French Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) insurance group, Jacques Friedmann, stresses importance of West African economic integration and harmonised commercial law in the region.
- Ivorian government and national entrepreneurs organise campaign to encourage Ivorians to buy local rather than imported products.
- Fraternite Matin, the government newspaper, launches children's supplement appearing first Wednesday of every month.
- Arrangements for Expo-CI trade fair, which run from Thursday to November 17, completed, organisers say. They urge exhibitors to ensure their stands are ready in time for the opening.
- Business leaders from Ivory Coast and France, its main trading partner, meet to discuss opportunities for further cooperation.
